ordering_semantics: THE LADDER ORDERS EARLIEST-LAWFUL-OBSERVATION INSTANTS OF CLAIMS. A horizon is not a workflow stage, not a quality tier, and not a confidence level — it is the earliest instant at which a claim of that class becomes lawfully observable at all. Rank N is strictly earlier-lawful than rank N+1: a fact that only becomes observable at rank N+1 CANNOT be truthfully asserted by an artifact whose own observation stopped at rank N, no matter how likely it is to be true. The total order is over HORIZONS, not over artifacts: an artifact is not required to traverse every rung (a canonical-side governance receipt may never reach `deployed`), and skipping a rung is lawful. What is NOT lawful is CLAIMING a rung whose observation has not occurred for that artifact.
artifact_lawful_horizon: An artifact's LAWFUL HORIZON is the highest-rank horizon whose observation has actually been performed FOR THAT ARTIFACT and can be pointed at. It is a measured property of the artifact's evidence, never a property of the author's intent or of the workflow's nominal stage.
refusal_target_of_the_h2_consumer: TYPED NOTE (the consumer this ladder is built for, NOT BUILT IN THIS INCREMENT): a receipt claim typed ABOVE its artifact's lawful horizon — claim rank > artifact rank — is the refusal target of H2, the receipt-intake horizon check (staging section 3, row H2: 'a receipt claim typed ABOVE its artifact's lawful horizon REFUSES with a typed error'). H2 is UNBUILT as of this file's landing: NO intake boundary consults this ladder, and NOTHING is refused anywhere in the federation because of it. This file plus its comparator are the vocabulary and the predicate H2 will read — they are not H2.

ladder.earliest_lawful_observation: the instant the bytes exist in the authoring tree and have been READ BACK from disk by the claimant. Authoring is not observation: a write whose result was never reopened has not reached even this rung.
ladder.does_not_entail: that any other machine, tree, or surface has ever seen the bytes.

ladder.earliest_lawful_observation: the instant the local emission to a remote returns success. This asserts the LOCAL side of a transfer completed.
ladder.does_not_entail: that the remote will serve those bytes to a reader — a push is EMISSION, and emission is not retrieval.

ladder.earliest_lawful_observation: the instant a READ addressed TO the remote resolves the exact declared subject (the exact sha / the exact ref), performed after the emission and returning the subject itself.
ladder.does_not_entail: that any independent machine can rebuild the artifact from what the remote served.

ladder.earliest_lawful_observation: the instant a machine carrying NONE of the authoring tree's state obtains the subject fresh and reproduces the declared artifact from it. The authoring machine cannot occupy this rung on its own behalf at any effort — the rung's content is the detachment.
ladder.does_not_entail: that the reproduced artifact has been placed into any installed or serving tree.

ladder.earliest_lawful_observation: the instant the installed tree's bytes are COMPARED, byte-for-byte, against the sole-writer lane's bytes, with the comparison's own output read.
ladder.does_not_entail: that the delivery surface is serving the artifact — parity of trees is not delivery.

ladder.earliest_lawful_observation: the instant the delivery surface itself reports the exact declared subject live under its own contract, read from that surface.
ladder.does_not_entail: that anything downstream of delivery has changed — delivery is not effect.

ladder.earliest_lawful_observation: the instant the deployed artifact's EFFECT is measured on the surface the claim is about, by an instrument that could have reported the effect's absence.
ladder.does_not_entail: anything beyond the measured window and the measured population — an outcome read is indexed to its own slice.

accretion: OPEN-BY-/REVIEW at the ladder's ENDS AND INTERIOR, and CLOSED to writers. A new horizon, a removed horizon, or a re-ordering is minted ONLY by a /review verdict, transcribed here as a data edit; the comparator then reads the amended file with no code change. This is the deliberate posture of its sibling landing-kind-enum-v1.json (open-by-/review), NOT the closed-at-N posture of pending-class-enum-v1.json. A value is NEVER coined at a write boundary and NEVER invented engine-side. THIS FILE IS NOT A CLOSURE OF THE HORIZON VOCABULARY; it is the current transcription of a ruled ordered set.
minting_authority: /review. The engine refuses an off-ladder value to ROUTE it to /review, never to declare the vocabulary complete. Take the horizon to /review; do not coin it at the call site, and never add a fallback order in code.
absence: A claim with NO horizon asserted is lawful and is NOT rank 0 — absence asserts nothing and must not be silently defaulted to any rung. The engine raises a typed refusal on an off-ladder value; it does not substitute a default. Fail-closed is the ruled posture: a missing or malformed ladder file is a typed refusal, never a fallback ordering, because a comparator that keeps working without its content has silently become a hardcoded engine.
